Proposition
[Covering maps are injective on $\pi _1$]

↗ prop:covering-homotopy-property ↗ def:loop-and-pi1-set

1. ch1:1.31\group Covering Spaces

For a pointed covering $p:(\widetilde X,\widetilde x_0)\to (X,x_0)$, $p_*$ is injective. Its image consists exactly of loop classes whose lifts from $\widetilde x_0$ are loops.

Proof

\sketch Lift a nullhomotopy of the projection of a loop; its lift joins the original loop to a constant loop, proving injectivity. A loop with a closed lift is visibly in the image, and homotopy lifting gives the converse.

□
